segments.sn2.8:1.2: Atha kho tāyano devaputto purāṇatitthakaro abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
segments.sn2.8:1.3: Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho tāyano devaputto bhagavato santike imā gāthāyo abhāsi –
segments.sn2.8:3.3: Sithilo hi paribbājo, bhiyyo ākirate rajaṃ.
segments.sn2.8:4.1: “Akataṃ dukkaṭaṃ [dukkataṃ (sī. pī.)] seyyo, pacchā tapati dukkaṭaṃ;
segments.sn2.8:4.3: Katañca sukataṃ seyyo, yaṃ katvā nānutappati.
segments.sn2.8:6.1: “Yaṃ kiñci sithilaṃ kammaṃ, saṃkiliṭṭhañca yaṃ vataṃ;
segments.sn2.8:6.3: Saṅkassaraṃ brahmacariyaṃ, na taṃ hoti mahapphalan”ti.
segments.sn2.8:7.2: idaṃ vatvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyīti.
segments.sn2.8:8.1: Atha kho bhagavā tassā rattiyā accayena bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.sn2.8:8.2: “imaṃ, bhikkhave, rattiṃ tāyano nāma devaputto purāṇatitthakaro abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
segments.sn2.8:8.3: Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho, bhikkhave, tāyano devaputto mama santike imā gāthāyo abhāsi –
segments.sn2.8:10.3: Sithilo hi paribbājo, bhiyyo ākirate rajaṃ.
segments.sn2.8:11.3: Katañca sukataṃ seyyo, yaṃ katvā nānutappati.
segments.sn2.8:13.1: “Yaṃ kiñci sithilaṃ kammaṃ, saṃkiliṭṭhañca yaṃ vataṃ;
segments.sn2.8:13.3: Saṅkassaraṃ brahmacariyaṃ, na taṃ hoti mahapphalan”ti.
segments.sn2.8:14.1: “Idamavoca, bhikkhave, tāyano devaputto, idaṃ vatvā maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyi.

lines: Ettha ca titthaṃ nāma dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhiyo, titthakaro nāma tāsaṃ uppādako satthā.
Ayaṃ pana diṭṭhiṃ uppādetvā kathaṃ sagge nibbattoti?
Esa kira uposathabhattādīni adāsi, anāthānaṃ vattaṃ paṭṭhapesi, patissaye akāsi, pokkharaṇiyo khaṇāpesi, aññampi bahuṃ kalyāṇaṃ akāsi.
So tassa nissandena sagge nibbatto, sāsanassa pana niyyānikabhāvaṃ jānāti.
So tathāgatassa santikaṃ gantvā sāsanānucchavikā vīriyappaṭisaṃyuttā gāthā vakkhāmīti āgantvā chinda sotantiādimāha.
Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – kāme ajahitvā muni jhānaṃ na upapajjati, na paṭilabhatīti attho.
Kayirā ce kayirāthenanti yadi vīriyaṃ kareyya, kareyyātha, taṃ vīriyaṃ na osakkeyya.
Bhiyyo ākirate rajanti atirekaṃ upari kilesarajaṃ ākirati.
Yaṃ kiñcīti na kevalaṃ dukkaṭaṃ katvā katasāmaññameva, aññampi yaṃ kiñci sithilaṃ kataṃ evarūpameva hoti.
Imasmiṃ hi sāsane paccayahetu samādinnadhutaṅgavataṃ saṃkiliṭṭhameva.
Saṅkassaranti saṅkāya saritaṃ,“idampi iminā kataṃ bhavissati, idampi iminā”ti evaṃ āsaṅkitaparisaṅkitaṃ.
Atītajātiyaṃ sayaṃkāravasena tāya diṭṭhiyā uppāditattā pubbe titthakaro.
Apare āhu “ayaṃ me satthāti gahaṇavasena titthakaro assa atthīti pubbe titthakaro, atītattabhāve titthakarasāvako”ti.
Te “diṭṭhiṃ uppādetvāti tassa satthuno diṭṭhiṃ ādāya gahetvāti attho”ti vadanti.
Titthaṃ nāma dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhiyo tabbinimuttassa micchāvādassa abhāvato.
Titthe niyuttāti titthikā, te eva titthiyāti vuttā ka-kārassa ya-kāraṃ katvā.
Upapajjatīti na uppajjati na pāpuṇātīti āha “na paṭilabhatī”ti.
Pabbajitavatasamādānassa adaḷhatāya ca tattha ca asakkaccakiriyāya sithilagahitā.
Dukkaṭaṃ akatameva seyyoti duccaritaṃ nāma sabbena sabbaṃ akatameva hitāvahaṃ.
Brahmacariyassa ādi ādibrahmacariyaṃ, tattha niyuttāti ādibrahmacariyikā, maggabrahmacariyassa pubbabhāgapaṭipadāti attho.
